newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Declining boxed beef values and expected lower fed prices next week.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Easier corn call may lend support but demand for feeders easing.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Stronger than expected pork product market and live called steady to higher.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Cash bellies rise and production down on light hog kills.
